label: Activity in the account of a capacity
term: priority in account in Aristotle, Metaphysics Θ.8
definition: An activity is prior in account to a capacity when the account of that capacity refers to that activity as its corresponding exercise, as the account of the capacity to build refers to building.
note: PriorInAccount takes the reference relation from a capacity to its exercise as a parameter. This is a comparison of activity and capacity by reference in the account. Its arguments have different roles from the two beings of RoutePrior, and it supplies no witness of an actual bearer.
